## User Story
**As a** [type of user, e.g., speech therapist / researcher / end user],  
**I want** [goal or capability, e.g., to upload an audio recording and detect stuttering events],  
**So that** [benefit or value, e.g., I can accurately assess speech disfluencies using CNN cepstral analysis].

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Criterion 1: Audio input (`.wav`) is accepted and preprocessed into cepstral features (MFCCs).
- [ ] Criterion 2: The Deep CNN model outputs predicted stuttering classifications with confidence scores.
- [ ] Criterion 3: Results are clearly displayed or logged without errors.

## Priority & Story Points
- **Priority:** High / Medium / Low
- **Story Points:** [e.g., 3]

## Additional Context / Notes
Add any relevant acoustic datasets, model constraints, or UI references here.
